outcome: Cord blood micronutrient concentrations (calcium, zinc, iron, vitamin A, magnesium, vitamin E, 25-hydroxy-vitamin D, vitamin B12)
cohort: The study included 56 newborns of mothers with prior Roux-en-Y gastric bypass and 56 newborns of nonobese healthy mothers after normal pregnancy.
finding: Neonates born to RYGB mothers were more likely to be small-for-gestational-age (23% vs 3.6%) and showed significant differences in cord blood micronutrient concentrations compared with neonates from healthy mothers.
